milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the sandstone structure and face it to demonstrate visual identification. The sandstone structure center is at (8, 1, 8) spawn-relative. max_distance=8 requires the player to walk partway toward the structure (it's ~11 blocks from spawn diagonally), ensuring they can't trigger it from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate close to a dead bush and face it. The dead bush at (5, 0, 8) spawn-relative is near the sandstone structure entrance, supporting the dependency chain. max_distance=5 requires the player to be close enough to clearly see the small plant (dead bushes are only ~1 block tall with thin branches). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.
